---
title: "How to Use This Programme"
---

For each module:

1. Complete the **core reading/lecture**.
2. Reproduce the key method **from scratch where feasible**.
3. Complete the **implementation task**.
4. Keep code, notes and results under version control.
5. Do not mark a module complete until you can explain the method, implement it and identify its assumptions.

A useful weekly allocation is approximately:

$$
3h\;\text{lectures} + 3h\;\text{reading/maths} + 4h\;\text{implementation} + 2h\;\text{replication}.
$$
